sources.title: Hermes 4 70B by NousResearch • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Hermes 4 Hermes 4 70B is a hybrid-mode reasoning model based on Llama-3.1-70B by Nous Research. Compared to Hermes 3, this model delivers enhanced mathematical and scientific reasoning, superior instruction following, and precise schema-adherent outputs with nuanced roleplay and creative writing capabilities.

sources.title: Hermes-4-70B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Hermes-4-70B is a frontier reasoning model built on Llama-3.1-70B by NousResearch, designed as an open, steerable alternative to closed-source models. The model uses a hybrid reasoning mode with explicit <think></think> segments that activate when deliberation helps—you can trigger this via the thinking=True flag or custom system prompts.
